quote: 1. If you buy things you do not need, soon you will have to sell things you need.
speaker: Warren Buffett

quote: 2. It takes 20 years to build a reputation and five minutes to ruin it. If you think about that, you'll do things differently.
speaker: Warren Buffett

quote: 3. Never forget the six-foot-tall man who drowned crossing the stream that was five feet deep on average.
speaker: Howard Marks

quote: 4. Never invest in a business you cannot understand.
speaker: Warren Buffett

quote: 5. Time is the friend of the wonderful business, the enemy of the mediocre.
speaker: Warren Buffett

quote: 6. Money is like soap: the more you touch it, the smaller it gets.
speaker: André Kostolany

quote: 7. Diversification is protection against ignorance. It makes little sense if you know what you are doing.
speaker: Warren Buffett

quote: 8. Once we realize that imperfect understanding is the human condition, there is no shame in being wrong, only in failing to correct our mistakes.
speaker: George Soros

quote: 9. The road to long-term investment success runs through risk control more than through aggressiveness.
speaker: Howard Marks

quote: 10. Honesty is a very expensive gift. Don't expect it from cheap people.
speaker: Warren Buffett

quote: 11. I made most of my money out of surprises because the majority is always wrong.
speaker: George Soros

quote: 12. Risk means more things can happen than will happen.
speaker: Howard Marks

quote: 13. Never ask a barber if you need a haircut.

quote: 14. Give me a strong economic argument and I'll gladly change my mind.

quote: 15. There's no such thing as a good idea regardless of price.

quote: 16. The difference between successful people and really successful people is that really successful people say no to almost everything.
speaker: Warren Buffett

quote: 17. You don't have to be brilliant, only a little wiser than the other guys, on average, for a long, long time.
speaker: Charlie Munger

quote: 18. On the stock exchange, two and two is never four, it's five minus one.
speaker: André Kostolany

quote: 19. Chains of habit are too light to be felt until they are too heavy to be broken.

quote: 20. Show me the incentive and I will show you the outcome.

quote: 21. I recognize that I might be wrong. This enables me to change my opinion without losing self-esteem.
speaker: George Soros

quote: 22. Someone's sitting in the shade today because someone planted a tree a long time ago.

quote: 23. The best thing a human being can do is to help another human being know more.
speaker: Charlie Munger

quote: 24. A successful speculator ages early, because the constant excitement affects his health and appearance.

quote: 25. Predicting rain doesn't count; building arks does.
speaker: Warren Buffett

quote: 26. The first rule of compounding: Never interrupt it unnecessarily.

quote: 27. I can't tell you how to get rich quickly; I can only tell you how to get poor quickly: by trying to get rich quickly.
speaker: André Kostolany

quote: 28. He who has money can speculate. He who has no money must not speculate. But he who has neither money nor patience should stay clear of the stock exchange altogether.
speaker: André Kostolany

quote: 29. Ideas are like children: none as beautiful as your own.
speaker: André Kostolany

quote: 30. Acquire worldly wisdom and adjust your behavior accordingly.
speaker: Charlie Munger

quote: 31. Forecasts may tell you a great deal about the forecaster; they tell you nothing about the future.
speaker: Warren Buffett

quote: 32. Someone will always be getting richer faster than you. This is not a tragedy.
speaker: Charlie Munger

quote: 33. Investment success doesn't come from 'buying good things,' but from 'buying things well.'
speaker: Howard Marks

quote: 34. Mimicking the herd invites regression to the mean.
speaker: Charlie Munger

quote: 35. Resisting - and thereby succeeding as a contrarian - requires the ability to withstand pain.
speaker: Howard Marks

quote: 36. There are only three ways to lose money: women, gambling, and technical analysis. My preference goes to the third method: it is the most reliable one.
speaker: André Kostolany

quote: 37. You only have to do a very few things right in your life so long as you don't do too many things wrong.
speaker: Warren Buffett

quote: 38. Financial markets generally are unpredictable.
speaker: George Soros

quote: 39. The stock market can never be understood 100 percent. It must remain a mystery, as is true of many things in life.
speaker: André Kostolany

quote: 40. The most important three words in investing are margin of safety.
speaker: Howard Marks

quote: 41. Invert, always invert.
speaker: Charlie Munger

quote: 42. I insist upon a right to be wrong.
speaker: George Soros

quote: 43. In my whole life, I have known no wise people who didn't read all the time – none, zero.
speaker: Charlie Munger

quote: 44. The worse a situation becomes, the less it takes to turn it around, and the bigger the upside.
speaker: George Soros

quote: 45. In investing, what is comfortable is rarely profitable.
speaker: Howard Marks

quote: 46. Price is what you pay. Value is what you get.
speaker: Warren Buffett

quote: 47. You must know the big ideas in the big disciplines and use them routinely – all of them, not just a few.
speaker: Charlie Munger

quote: 48. The whole stock market depends only on whether there are more shares than idiots or more idiots than shares.
speaker: André Kostolany

quote: 49. If you don't feel comfortable owning something for 10 years, then don't own it for 10 minutes.
speaker: Warren Buffett

quote: 50. Being too far ahead of your time is indistinguishable from being wrong.

quote: 51. It is waste of time to keep going over the past instead of using the energy to change the future.
speaker: Charlie Munger

quote: 52. The desire to get rich fast is pretty dangerous.
speaker: Charlie Munger

quote: 53. Experience is what you got when you didn't get what you wanted.

quote: 54. Buy stocks, take sleeping pills, and don't look at the prices.
speaker: André Kostolany

quote: 55. Take a simple idea and take it seriously.

quote: 56. All intelligent investing is value investing — acquiring more than you are paying for.
speaker: Charlie Munger

quote: 57. Whoever wants to become rich quickly will die poor.
speaker: André Kostolany

quote: 58. You're paying less to brokers, you're listening to less nonsense, and if it works, the tax system gives you an extra one, two, or three percentage points per annum.
speaker: Charlie Munger

quote: 59. You can't predict. You can prepare.
speaker: Howard Marks

quote: 60. I'm only rich because I know when I'm wrong.

quote: 61. The most important quality for an investor is temperament, not intellect.
speaker: Warren Buffett

quote: 62. Markets are constantly in a state of uncertainty and flux, and money is made by discounting the obvious and betting on the unexpected.
speaker: George Soros

quote: 63. In the absence of something needing to be paid for, price and value can diverge substantially.
speaker: Howard Marks

quote: 64. Our favorite holding period is forever.
speaker: Warren Buffett

quote: 65. Reflexivity is a two-way feedback mechanism in which reality helps shape the participants' thinking and the participants' thinking helps shape reality.
speaker: George Soros

quote: 66. Money that is easily made is easily lost.
speaker: André Kostolany

quote: 67. In the business world, the rearview mirror is always clearer than the windshield.
speaker: Warren Buffett

quote: 68. The big money is not in the buying and selling, but in the waiting.
speaker: Charlie Munger

quote: 69. It's not whether you're right or wrong, but how much money you make when you're right and how much you lose when you're wrong.

quote: 70. Risk comes from not knowing what you are doing.

quote: 71. Knowing what you don't know is more useful than being brilliant.
speaker: Charlie Munger

quote: 72. Money is never lost, it is simply transferred from one pocket to another.
speaker: André Kostolany

quote: 73. The best investment you can make is in yourself.

quote: 74. I'm not in the game to disprove or prove some hypothesis; I'm in it to make money.
speaker: George Soros

quote: 75. The stock market is 90 percent psychology.
speaker: André Kostolany

quote: 76. Spend each day trying to be a little wiser than you were when you woke up.

quote: 77. My approach works not by making valid predictions but by allowing me to correct false ones.
speaker: George Soros

quote: 78. A speculator is one who observes the future and acts before it occurs.
speaker: André Kostolany

quote: 79. It's not supposed to be easy. Anyone who finds it easy is stupid.
speaker: Charlie Munger

quote: 80. There's nothing wrong with a forecast that turns out to be dead wrong. What's wrong is believing in it in the first place.
speaker: Howard Marks

quote: 81. Anyone who is not a millionaire but has one million in debt is a millionaire.
speaker: André Kostolany

quote: 82. Be fearful when others are greedy and greedy when others are fearful.
speaker: Warren Buffett

quote: 83. It is not necessary to do extraordinary things to get extraordinary results.
speaker: Warren Buffett

quote: 84. The safest way to try to get what you want is to try to deserve what you want. It's such a simple idea.
speaker: Charlie Munger

quote: 85. You can't do the same things others do and expect to outperform.
speaker: Howard Marks

quote: 86. All I want to know is where I'm going to die, so I'll never go there.
speaker: Charlie Munger

quote: 87. Rule number one: most things will prove to be cyclical. Rule number two: some of the greatest opportunities for gain and loss come when other people forget rule number one.
speaker: Howard Marks

quote: 88. Anyone who doesn't possess shares should buy some; anyone who already has shares should hold on to them; and anyone who has neither shares nor money should sell his shirt and buy shares.
speaker: André Kostolany

quote: 89. Markets are always wrong in the sense that they present a biased view of the future.
speaker: George Soros

quote: 90. Money made on the stock exchange is like a loan – you have to give it back sooner or later.
speaker: André Kostolany
